messages:
maya.su: FYI we've got a spike of customers reporting missing usage rows in the Console (metrics delayed ~3-6h). Seeing alerts from the hourly-rollup consumer. :eyes:
samir.eng: Can you paste the alert link and affected tenant IDs?
maya.su: https://console.redwood.ai/alerts/ALRT-7832 - initial list: tenant_112, tenant_203, tenant_617 (roughly 150 tenants in the alert window). Dashboard shows '0 tokens' for many hours.
priya-analytics: I pulled the consumer logs, there's an exception in the ETL job around parquet write: `org.apache.parquet.io.ParquetEncodingException: Failed to append column usage_type` after a schema change.
arun-reliability: Was there a deploy/commit touching the usage pipeline earlier?
maya.su: Deployments: there was a small schema migration merged to ingestion-service at 19:12 today (PR #4521) to add usage_type enum.
samir.eng: OK that aligns. The consumer expects the old Avro schema; new messages with usage_type are causing the writer to fail, which leads to the consumer skipping batches and backlog growing.
nate-oncall: Repro steps I ran: 1) tail kafka topic usage-events for a tenant 2) produce a message with new field usage_type:"realtime" 3) consumer throws the parquet exception and the hourly job retries 5 times then marks partition errored.
priya-analytics: Log snippet: ```2026-08-03 19:14:03 ERROR parquet.Writer - ParquetEncodingException: mismatch column schema: usage_type (expected INT32, got STRING) at /data/ingest/job-47/part-0004.parquet```
maya.su: Impact: rollups for the hour failed, backfill hasn't started. Console shows hourly gaps.
arun-reliability: Short-term mitigation: revert the schema change OR patch consumer to be tolerant. Which is faster?
samir.eng: Patch to consumer to treat unknown fields as null will take ~2-3 hrs including QA. Reverting migration (PR revert) is ~15-30 mins but requires coord with infra to avoid re-processing.
priya-analytics: Suggest revert + manual replay of the 3 affected partitions after revert. I'll prepare replay script.
nate-oncall: I'll post a temporary maintenance note on the Console and mark the alert as investigating. :hammer:
maya.su: Replay checklist from Priya: 1) revert ingestion-service schema commit; 2) deploy revert; 3) run consumer-check to ensure no parquet errors; 4) trigger `ingest-backfill --topic usage-events --start-offset 160234500 --end-offset 160235900 --tenants tenant_112,tenant_203,tenant_617` 5) monitor `select max(hour) from usage_hourly where tenant_id in (...)`
priya-analytics: Replay script (WIP): ```#!/bin/bash
echo "Starting replay"
python tools/replay.py --topic usage-events --from-offset 160234500 --to-offset 160235900 --dry-run
# then without --dry-run once ok
```
samir.eng: Also adding an invariant check to post-commit CI to prevent incompatible schema changes for the ingestion Avro.
maya.su: ETA: revert PR queued, infra on call to deploy in ~20m. I'll update here after deploy and a first verification run.
console-bot: Incident note created: INC-2026-08-03-usage-delay, severity: high, owner: support, status: investigating.
maya.su: Update 20m: revert deployed, consumer restarted, initial verification shows parquet errors stopped. Starting backfill now (step 4).
priya-analytics: Backfill running. Current progress: 35% of targeted offsets. No new parquet exceptions.
arun-reliability: Keep an eye on downstream rollups; if we see duplicates, we may need idempotency dedupe.
maya.su: Closing loop: backfill completed ~2h later, dashboards repopulated, customers notified. Action items: samir to add CI schema gating, priya to document replay steps, arun to add alert that links to consumer error logs.
samir.eng: Filed follow-ups: DOCS-789 (replay runbook), CI-372 (schema gate).
priya-analytics: Reopen if you spot any residual gaps. :white_check_mark:
